versions.content: category s for the definition of a ModeDeclarationGroup In order to support a clear separation between the two possible ways to influence the definition of the programmatic representation of ModeDeclaration s two category s shall be defined for the definition of a ModeDeclarationGroup . • The value of category of a ModeDeclarationGroup shall be set to EX- PLICIT_ORDER if it is intended to control the source code generation by means of the values of the attributes ModeDeclaration . value and ModeDeclara- tionGroup . onTransitionValue . • The value of category of a ModeDeclarationGroup shall be set to ALPHA- BETIC_ORDER if it is intended to let the RTE generator control the source code generation according to the alphabetical sorting.
